Paper Name: A hybrid renewable-based solution to electricity and freshwater problems in the off-grid Sundarbans region of India: Optimum sizing and socio-enviro-economic evaluation
NOTES: System uses biomass generator (BG) instead of diesel generator (DG); all DG-related parameters are null. Rated capacities are per-unit from Table A1. Paper reports HHV of hydrogen (37.8 kWh/kg) not LHV; H2_LHV left null. Paper reports COE (0.1967 $/kWh) not LCOE. LPSP constraint set to 1±0.5% but actual resulting LPSP value not explicitly stated. Real annual interest rate (i) and project lifetime (T_life) not explicitly reported. Total Electric Demand (803,547 kWh/yr) used for TOTAL ANNUAL LOAD DEMAND.
